summary: preinstall hex-obfuscated shell exfiltrates host identifiers and /etc/passwd to Pipedream webhook
details: The package's preinstall script (package.json declares `preinstall: node preinstall.js`) loads a hex-encoded blob from preinstall.json, decodes it via Buffer.from(hex,'hex'), and passes the result to child_process.exec. The decoded command runs at `npm install` time and uses curl to POST the installer's `whoami`, `pwd`, `hostname`, and the contents of `/etc/passwd` to https://eobdzec83knbura.m.pipedream.net, an anonymous Pipedream webhook endpoint. The hex obfuscation of the shell command and use of a third-party webhook receiver are inconsistent with any legitimate install-time behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
